<?php
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool {
        global $reader;
        echo "I:", $incoming, ";";
        if ($incoming === "drop") { $reader = null; }
        return $incoming !== "";
    }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): never { echo "BAD_GET;"; throw new Exception("get-called"); }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("terminal-isset"); }
};
$selector = "yes";
echo isset($reader->$selector) ? "YES;" : "BAD_YES;";
$selector = "";
echo isset($reader->$selector) ? "BAD_NO;" : "NO;";
$selector = "drop";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = isset($reader->$selector); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious() === null ? "NO_PREVIOUS;" : "BAD_PREVIOUS;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "drop" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
$intReader = new class {
    private int $hidden = 7;
    public function __get(string $incoming): int { echo "BAD_INT_GET;"; return null; }
};
$arrayReader = new class {
    private int $hidden = 9;
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): array { echo "BAD_ARRAY_GET;"; return 99; }
};
echo empty($intReader->hidden) ? "INT_SKIP;" : "BAD_INT;";
echo empty($arrayReader->hidden) ? "ARRAY_SKIP;" : "BAD_ARRAY;";
echo "DONE;";
